Class EyeItemServiceGameTestsLogic

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.gametest.EyeItemServiceGameTestsLogic
public final class EyeItemServiceGameTestsLogic extends Object
EyeItemService.interact(Player, Level, InteractionHand, Entity) (the Optometrist right-click harvest) and EyeItemService.selfRemoveWithShears(Player, InteractionHand) (sneak + shears on air). The shears-on-kill harvest and the Slimy Eye application verb are covered by SomeGooglyGameTestsLogic and EligibilityGameTestsLogic. LoaderInteractionGameTestsLogic drives the same uses through each loader's own events or callbacks, including refusal by a protection listener on NeoForge and Forge; Fabric's protection-listener ordering is checked by hand.

For the in-game steps below, get Optometrist shears from an Optometrist book in an anvil, or with /give @s shears[enchantments={levels:{"somegoogly:optometrist":1}}].

  • Method Details

    • anotherPlayersEyesFollowThePvpRules

      public static void anotherPlayersEyesFollowThePvpRules(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Eyes go on or come off another player only where you could hurt them. In game, on a server with pvp=false: right-click another player with a Slimy Eye, then give them eyes with /sg admin eyes true and right-click them with Optometrist shears; nothing happens either way and nothing is spent. With pvp=true, put both players on a team with friendlyFire false and repeat; nothing happens. With friendlyFire true the shears take the eyes.

    • optometristInteractHarvestsEyesForOneDurability

      public static void optometristInteractHarvestsEyesForOneDurability(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player)
      Right-click an eyed, configured mob with Optometrist shears: one eye drops, eyes clear, one durability. In game: give a cow eyes and an iris color with /sg admin eyes true and /sg admin tint iris 0.2 0.6 0.9, then right-click it in survival with Optometrist shears; its eyes vanish, one Googly Eye with that iris color drops, and the shears lose one durability.

    • optometristInteractPassesWhenNotApplicable

      public static void optometristInteractPassesWhenNotApplicable(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player)
      Every non-qualifying right-click passes to the vanilla interaction and spends nothing. In game: on an eyed sheep, a stick does nothing and plain shears shear its wool as usual; Optometrist shears do nothing to an eyeless cow, nor to an eyed one while googlyEyesEnabled = false. No eye drops and the Optometrist shears keep full durability.

    • optometristRollsOnlyOntoShearsAndBooks

      public static void optometristRollsOnlyOntoShearsAndBooks(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper)
      Loot that rolls enchantments by level from the random-loot set can put Optometrist on shears or a book but on nothing else. In game: run /loot give @s loot minecraft:chests/end_city_treasure many times; no tool, weapon, or armor piece comes with Optometrist.

    • selfRemoveWithShearsDropsAnEyeAndCostsDurability

      public static void selfRemoveWithShearsDropsAnEyeAndCostsDurability(net.minecraft.gametest.framework.GameTestHelper helper, net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player)
      Sneak + shears on air removes your own eyes for one durability, whether or not the shears carry Optometrist; only a non-sneaking use is left to the vanilla item. The plain-shears self-damage (a melee hit's worth of health) is not asserted here — fake players are inert to hurt — and stays source-verified. In game: apply a Slimy Eye to yourself, then sneak and right-click the air with Optometrist shears; your eyes come off, one Googly Eye drops, the shears lose one durability, and you take no damage. Repeat with plain shears and you also lose some health. Without sneaking, or with googlyEyesEnabled = false, nothing happens. A protection listener's refusal is checked through the loader's hook by LoaderInteractionGameTestsLogic.useHooksHonorResults(GameTestHelper, ServerPlayer, LoaderInteractionGameTestsLogic.Use, boolean). Callback ordering needs a connected client; this service test bypasses the loader callback.
